risks.title: Operational results variability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first and described as having a direct impact on the stock price and potentially leading to litigation. The language is repetitive and emphasizes the inability to reduce fixed costs in the short term. Central position in the 10-K. High weighting for a financial risk.

risks.title: Failure to innovate amid competition
risks.score_rationale: Strong language: 'substantially decrease or delay market acceptance', 'lose existing customers'. The risk is tied to the survival of the business model in a rapidly evolving market. Positioned early in the document, with an exhaustive list of failure causes. Category 'Competition' highly weighted.

risks.title: Platform scalability challenges
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights the significant investment required and the complexity of technologies. Mentions concrete risks if the platform fails to keep up with customer growth. Concerned tone ('may be harmed'). Strategic placement after business risks.

risks.title: Risk of subscription non-renewal
risks.score_rationale: The SaaS model relies on renewals. The text stresses the absence of renewal obligation and the direct impact on revenue growth. Clear and repeated language ('revenues may grow more slowly or decline'). Central risk for revenue recurrence.

risks.title: Cyberattacks on platform or vendors
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language: 'targeted for cyber-attacks', 'materially disrupt', 'loss of FedRAMP authorization'. Existential risk as the company sells security solutions. Mentions state-sponsored threats and malicious AI. Positioned later but with high intensity.

risks.title: Dependence on R&D developments
risks.score_rationale: The text acknowledges that R&D efforts are costly and offer no return guarantee. Explicit mention of a 'material and adverse' impact if investment fails. Positioned after business risks, but severity emphasized.

risks.title: Increased geopolitical risks in cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Specific mention of tensions in Eastern Europe and the Middle East as aggravating factors. Language reinforcing the threat ('heightened risks', 'nation-state actors'). Appears as an escalation compared to prior years. Geopolitical category on the rise.

ai_positioning.summary: The company QLYS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
